description: Calculates Body Mass Index (BMI) using weight and height in either metric (kg, cm) or imperial (lbs, inches) systems. Formula: weight / (height²). (cost: 1 credit)

height.description: number, required, body height, cm or inches depending on system, no default

system.description: string, optional, measurement system (metric/imperial), no unit, default metric

weight.description: number, required, body weight, kg or lbs depending on system, no default

name: calculate_bmi
